headlines.title: Supreme Court says New Hampshire student IDs can’t be used to vote in November
headlines.description: In a win for Republicans, the court said a federal judge should not have changed the rules so close to the Nov. 3 midterm elections.

headlines.title: Trump ordered to sit for deposition in BBC lawsuit
headlines.description: A federal judge in Florida ordered President Donald Trump to sit for a deposition in his defamation lawsuit against the BBC by Dec. 11, or face the possibility of having his $10 billion action dismissed.

headlines.title: Tom Skerritt, star of ‘Alien’ and ‘Top Gun,’ dies at 93
headlines.description: Skerritt, a prolific actor with dozens of screen credits, was also an Emmy winner for his lead role on the cult favorite series “Picket Fences.”

headlines.title: Airbnb introduces new cleaning rules to lessen the burden on guests
headlines.description: Mixed reactions pour in following a new policy change from Airbnb limiting guest chores, such as washing dishes and stripping bedsheets. NBC News' Vicky Nguyen has the story.

headlines.title: Ohio gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton condemns ad featuring her estranged mother
headlines.description: Ohio Democratic gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton is condemning a new ad circulating online featuring her estranged mother. NBC News national politics reporter Henry Gomez discusses how close the race between Acton and Republican candidate Vivek Ramaswamy has become in the campaign's final two weeks.

headlines.title: Hackers appear to be struggling to exploit PHP flaws after global cybersecurity crisis
headlines.description: There were few, if any, reports of widespread damage by hackers exploiting PHP flaws, experts said, one day after officials warned of severe vulnerabilities.

headlines.title: Ramaswamy’s ad splits the GOP in Ohio’s closing stretch: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Jonathan Allen digs into the fallout from a controversial ad that has roiled Ohio politics.

headlines.title: Manuel Otto, German video game creator, dies after apparently livestreaming his suicide
headlines.description: German video game designer and influencer Manuel Otto apparently took his own life while doing a livestream on Twitch, according to the streaming platform and his colleagues.

headlines.title: Despite security concerns, NFL plans to stage Paris game amid French protests
headlines.description: The NFL will host its first game in Paris on Sunday between the New Orleans Saints and Pittsburgh Steelers despite widespread protests across France.

headlines.title: Top adviser to Kennedy resigns from Trump administration
headlines.description: Calley Means, a key adviser to health secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and central advocate for the “Make America Healthy Again” movement, is leaving the Trump administration.
